title: August 2026 fresh-intake production - batch G1 (four genuine-new asks and four examiner follow-up limbs from the cross-batch reconciliation of submissions S003 and S004)
note: First production batch driven by the CURRENT August intake rather than by the historical 788. Its authorisation is the per-occurrence adjudication record, so every card here traces to a specific AUG-* occurrence that a named candidate actually reported at the August 2026 Kochi sitting. Four occurrences adjudicated GENUINE_NEW_QUESTION become cards; four adjudicated FOLLOWUP enrich the existing card that already owns the parent ask, because flattening an examiner follow-up into a new card is how the bank grows duplicates. NOTE ON EXAMINER ATTRIBUTION: none of these eight cards names an examiner. The panel is known and is NOT constant - Rajappan external with Senthil internal for submissions S001-S003, Nair external with Senthil internal for S004 - but only TWO occurrences in the whole intake carry a per-question attribution, AUG-0032 and AUG-0040, both to Senthil and both written by the candidate. A card is not the place to record a panel-level fact. The examiner index confirms this independently: relationships are unchanged at 958 across this batch. NOTE ON authorisation_batch_key: the adjudication record carries no batches[] node, so the key is an identity label asserted against batch_id, while the real selector is the per-card source_occurrence_ids, which validate_batch_g1.py resolves in the adjudication record and cross-checks field by field.
